  ↑{d ∈ Roth.box (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) |
          Roth.weight r (Finsupp.mapDomain Fin.castSucc d + Finsupp.single (Fin.last n) i) ≤
            (↑(n + 1) - lam) / 2}.card =

          Roth.weight (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) d ≤ (↑n - (lam - 1 + 2 * ↑i / ↑(r (Fin.last n)))) / 2}.card
